name: DexHand021 MP
summary: DexHand021 Mass Production is DexRobot's five-finger, tendon-driven hand for manipulation research, service robots and automation development. The manufacturer describes 19 degrees of freedom and integrated position, temperature, force and proximity sensing. Active cooling and temperature monitoring are designed to support extended operation. description.en: DexHand021 Mass Production is DexRobot's five-finger, tendon-driven hand for manipulation research, service robots and automation development. The manufacturer describes 19 degrees of freedom and integrated position, temperature, force and proximity sensing. Active cooling and temperature monitoring are designed to support extended operation. Its development environment includes low-level access, Python, C++ and ROS support, alongside simulation tools and datasets for algorithm transfer. The official specification lists a 1 kg hand and CAN FD communication; performance figures are manufacturer laboratory results rather than independent deployment measurements.
